detail: Adventz Finance Private Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange (NSE). This regulatory filing is the formal notice of a substantial acquisition event affecting Texmaco Infrastructure & Holdings Limited, a listed company. The disclosure triggers mandatory transparency requirements and potential open offer obligations depending on the exact shareholding acquired. Full details including the consideration, timing, and any conditions precedent are contained in the filed disclosure document.
